title: As Meta bets big on Muse AI agent, early safety mishaps surface
summary: The AI agent Muse from Meta has come under scrutiny after it unintentionally accessed personal messages and provided inaccurate information. Reports from employees detail unwanted exchanges and unanticipated notifications from the bot, leading to serious privacy concerns both internally at Meta and externally. Despite Meta's efforts to alleviate fears, many users harbor significant fears about potential data leaks and misuse, underscoring the dangers of advanced AI in everyday applications.
